decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development shall be constructed in strict accordance with the drawings hereby approved or drawings which are subsequently approved pursuant to conditions which are attached to this planning permission.

Condition : 2 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.
description:
Variation of condition 06 on previously approved application
9401947R3 (granted on 09/09/95) to substitute amended plans
showing minor variations including the deletion of basement,
alteration to the internal layout, enclosure of balcony/
terraces within internal courtyard, enlargement of entrance
conservatory and alterations to the fenestration pattern.
As shown on drawing nos.  S 528/013D*, 014D*, 015D*, 016D*,
2 X unnumbered.
